title: The CodeNewbie Podcast is Back for Season 28!
why_read: A podcast relaunch announcement with no technical content, of interest mainly to beginners seeking community and mentorship.
analysis: This post announces the return of the CodeNewbie Podcast for a new season focused on building with AI, introducing a new host. It's a community and marketing announcement rather than technical material, aimed at coding newcomers. There's no code, architecture, or research content to evaluate. It may have value for beginners looking for inspiration but is not relevant to an experienced engineering audience.
